item.title: Cory Doctorow: Agents vs ecommerce — Opacity is a feature, not a bug
item.description: Ecommerce sites were never going to welcome agentic comparison-shopping: surveillance pricing, drip pricing and junk fees — the source of all recent profit growth — require the opacity that agents would destroy.
